_comment: The web indexer catalog: ready-made definitions the plugin offers with one-click Add under Settings → yt-dlp → Web search. Fetched at runtime from this repository's main branch, so adding a site here reaches every user WITHOUT a plugin release. Every entry must pass validateWebIndexerDef and be pinned by a fixture test in test/webindexers.test.js — and its site must be one yt-dlp can actually play (Audius is deliberately absent: its search API works, but yt-dlp's audius extractor is currently broken, and a one-click site whose plays fail is worse than none). The optional top-level `description` is shown in the catalog UI and travels with the def on install.

indexers.name: Mixcloud
indexers.description: DJ mixes, radio shows and podcasts — searched by mix title.

indexers.name: Niconico
indexers.description: Japan's video community — title search, most-viewed first.

indexers.description: Video items on archive.org — concerts, TV, film. Title-matched, ranked by downloads.
